evals.prompt: I need to add a new scraper for Reuters news. Can you scaffold the scraper target file, wire it into the scraper routine, and add the MemoryKeyStore route? The URL is https://www.reuters.com/news/world and I want to scrape article headlines with links and timestamps. Use the selector 'article[data-testid="headline"]' for each item, with h3 for the title and time for the timestamp.
evals.expected_output: Creates src/scraper/target/reuters.target.ts, updates src/lib/services/scraper-routine.service.ts to include the new target, and adds a GET /reuters route to src/routes/v1/scraper.route.ts

evals.prompt: I want to add a new route group for a market-data API under /api/v1/market-data. It should have a GET /api/v1/market-data/summary endpoint that reads from MemoryKeyStore and returns the latest scraped financialjuice data. Create the route file, add the barrel export, and wire it into app.ts.
evals.expected_output: Creates src/routes/v1/market-data.route.ts, updates src/routes/index.ts, and updates src/app.ts to register the new route group

evals.prompt: I need to add an entity for storing market sentiment analysis results. The table should be called 'market_sentiment' with fields: id (uuid), source (varchar), sentiment_score (float), summary (text), analyzed_at (varchar timestamp), and asset_class (varchar). Create the entity file, add it to the barrel export, register it in db.ts and db-init.ts.
evals.expected_output: Creates src/supabase/entities/market-sentiment.entity.ts, updates src/supabase/entities/index.ts, src/lib/db.ts, and src/lib/db-init.ts

evals.prompt: Add a new service called AlertService that sends notifications when market thresholds are crossed. It should read from MemoryKeyStore and have a method checkThresholds() that compares current prices against configured thresholds from env vars. Create the service, instantiate it in app.ts, decorate it, and add the type to apollo.d.ts.
evals.expected_output: Creates src/lib/services/alert.service.ts, updates src/app.ts, and updates src/types/apollo.d.ts
